note: Village of Thedford park at the US-83/NE-2 junction in the Sandhills, on Main St just south of Hwy 2; rail line ~150 m south. No village web page describes the campground: camper reports describe 3-4 back-in RV spots with 30-amp electric, a water tap, tent space and a donation box by the pavilion, and disagree on whether there is a dump station. FCFS. --Claude
summary: No village page exists for the park; the community site visitthedford.com names 'Thedford City Park, West Hwy 2' as a tourism stop only, and visitnebraska.com is blocked. Google Maps has an open listing (4.2 stars, 26 reviews) with the Village of Thedford's phone 308-645-2201. Cleared directory-only hookups, dump and season (directories disagree on the dump); note rewritten to attribute the details to camper reports. Pin within the park. Presence is thin: flagged.
flags: PRESENCE (public-campground ladder, weak): no village/agency page or document names it as a campground; visitthedford.com (a community/Service Club site) lists 'Thedford City Park, West Hwy 2' under Tourism with no camping detail; visitnebraska.com/thedford answers 403 (a search summary of it mentions other Thedford camping listings, not this park). What shows it operates: Google Maps open listing 'Thedford Village Park & Campground' 4.2 stars / 26 reviews with phone 308-645-2201, and camper reports. A human decides whether that is enough under the ladder.

PHONE: none stored. 308-645-2201 is the Village of Thedford ('Rhonda Haumann/The Village of Thedford (308-645-2201) for Water, Trash, and Sewer', https://www.visitthedford.com/), and Google's listing for the park carries the same number. apply.py does not write phone.
NO POSTED TERMS: no fee, donation amount, hookups or season stated by the village; fees stay empty. Directory reports: free, donation box by the pavilion.
